claims.quote: KIF1A is a neuron-specific member of the kinesin-3 family of microtubule (MT) plus-end-directed motor proteins.

claims.object_text: migration of nuclei in differentiating brain stem cells
claims.quote: powers the migration of nuclei in differentiating brain stem cells
the transport of synaptic precursors and dense core vesicles in axons.
Its dysfunction causes severe neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative diseases termed KIF1A-associated neurological disorders (KAND).

claims.object_text: tail-truncated dimeric KIF1A expressed in E. coli and studied by single-molecule TIRF and optical tweezers assays
claims.quote: express a tail-truncated dimeric KIF1A in E. coli cells and provide step-by-step protocols for performing single-molecule studies with total internal reflection fluorescence microscopy and optical tweezers assays
